heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋分群標題列網格
desc: 置中標題組下方是左右兩個群組，各有一條群組標題列，下面排列無外框的圖片項目，最下方置中一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放一段較大的次要文字與小字說明，沒有時省略。標題組下方是左右並排、等寬的兩個群組，合起來對齊頁面內容寬度。每個群組上方有一條橫跨群組寬度的群組標題列：左端放一組小圖示，標題置中在列內，標題列右上方可放小字的次要文字，沒有時省略。群組標題列下方是數個等寬的項目並排，兩個群組的項目排成同一列、同一高度。每個項目無外框：橫式圖片在上，所有圖片同一比例，圖片左上角疊放一組小標籤；圖片下方置中放標題與次要文字。網格下方置中可放一顆按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 兩個群組改為直向堆疊，每個群組的群組標題列在上、項目在下；項目改為直向堆疊，每列一個，橫跨頁面內容寬度，圖片比例略為變高但仍為橫式。按鈕仍置中放在最後一個群組下方。

en.name: Centered heading + grouped grid with header bars
en.desc: Below a centered heading group sit two side-by-side groups, each with a group header bar over frameless image items, with a centered button at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a larger piece of secondary text and a small caption below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group are two equal-width groups side by side that together align with the page content width. Each group has a group header bar spanning the group width at the top: a set of small icons at the left end and the title centered within the bar, optionally with small secondary text above the right end of the bar; omit it when there is no content. Below each header bar, several equal-width items sit side by side, and the items of both groups form a single row of equal height. Each item has no frame: a landscape image on top, all images in the same aspect ratio, with a set of small labels overlaid on the top-left corner of the image; below the image, a title and secondary text are centered. Optionally place a button centered below the grid; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: The two groups stack vertically, each with its header bar on top and its items below; the items stack vertically, one per row, spanning the page content width, with images slightly taller but still landscape. The button stays centered below the last group.
